summary: Implemented personas/build-personas.js with full template engine (partials → conditionals → variables)

Template engine: resolvePartials (depth 2), resolveConditionals ({{#if}}), resolveVariables ({{var}}) with WARN on unknown
Post-processing: collapseBlankLines (4+ newlines → 3), trimEnd
Outputs: AUTO-GENERATED header + generated frontmatter + rendered body

comments.note: Pre-existing TypeScript error in mcp-server/src/utils/ledger-root.ts:27 blocked check-known-roles.js. `args[flagIndex + 1].startsWith('--')` was not guarded against undefined. Fixed with non-null assertion: `args[flagIndex + 1]!.startsWith('--')`. This is pre-existing debt, not introduced by this WP.

sync-personas.js skips all generated ledger files because they start with the AUTO-GENERATED HTML comment rather than '---'. The AC 'reads without error' is satisfied (exit 0), but the files are not actually synced to VS Code. WP-006 must update sync-personas.js to handle the comment prefix, OR the build script must strip the comment from the content it writes to disk (placing it as an in-frontmatter YAML comment instead).

tools_json serialized as YAML single-quote flow format (['vscode', ...]) instead of JSON.stringify format as specified in the plan. This preserves byte-identical round-trip fidelity with the original files (required by WP-006 AC). Intentional deviation from plan spec, documented here.

summary: Reviewed personas/build-personas.js (344 lines) in full
Template engine: resolvePartials → resolveConditionals → resolveVariables → collapseBlankLines pipeline is correct and well-ordered
resolveConditionals regex handles leading/trailing newlines around blocks cleanly, preventing paragraph merging
serializeTools YAML single-quote format matches existing file format — intentional, correct
Stale check: full output computed and string-compared to disk — deterministic and correct
ledger-root.ts fix: bounds check guards the non-null assertion; logic is safe and regression-tested (302 tests)
Minor: no_detect_project in context is dead code; non-null assertion in ledger-root.ts is safe but redundant

comments.note: build-personas.js is well-structured and clean for a ~340-line build script. Clear section separators, JSDoc on all helper functions, explicit 'use strict'. No external deps beyond js-yaml.

Template pipeline ordering (partials → conditionals → variables) is correct. Resolving partials first is important so that partial content can itself contain conditionals and variables. Depth-2 recursion cap is safe and sufficient for the current partial structure.

context object: `no_detect_project: !persona.has_detect_project` is computed but unused — no template references {{no_detect_project}} or {{#if no_detect_project}}. The PM template uses the mcp-preflight-verify-no-detect partial directly. This is dead context data — harmless but can be removed.

ledger-root.ts fix (line 27): bounds check added correctly with `flagIndex + 1 >= args.length ||`. The `!` non-null assertion that follows is now safe but technically redundant after the bounds guard. Consider removing `!` in a follow-up cleanup.

path.join(__dirname, 'node_modules', 'js-yaml') explicit resolution is good defensive practice — prevents js-yaml from resolving to a parent-level node_modules and accidentally picking up a different version.
